audit.whatIsWrong: The entry says Hijack "steals your Let's Bounce! and turns it against your team" but never gives the numbers that make it a standing rule.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30 seconds. Let's Bounce! is 120/105/90. Sylas gets a copy of Zac's ultimate back faster than Zac gets his own — at rank 3 it is 30s against 90s. That reframes the advice from "be careful at 6" to "you are permanently the one on the longer cooldown", which is the real reason to hold R. Hijack's cast range is 950.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] says "Level 1 Sylas's chain combo out-trades Zac immediately."
audit.why: Sylas has one ability at level 1 — there is no chain combo. The level-1 threat is Chain Lash alone, which slows on impact and detonates a beat later at the intersection point.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[0] around the single spell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kingslayer is named as a heal repeatedly ("your W burst barely dents his self-heal") but Grievous Wounds is never mentioned in the content layer.
audit.why: Kingslayer is the entire reason Sylas wins the early trades described, it only heals against champions, and it is cast from 400 range — melee. Anti-heal is not a rounding factor here, it is the switch that flips the trade pattern the entry spends three fields complaining about.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal written into early, whys[3] and spikes[0].text as the named answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content level chart gives Sylas all 7 stages while Zac wins 51.94% over 360 games — the largest sample in my slice. The full layer meanwhile gives Zac four stages.
audit.why: A 7/7 sweep asserts a losing matchup. 51.94% over 360 games is a real, if slim, Zac edge, and the two layers cannot both be right.
audit.corrected: Sylas keeps levels 1-2 and level 6 (Hijack); 3 and 4-5 become Skill; first item and 2+ items become Zac.

audit.whatIsWrong: late says "don't try to solo him — force fights where he's already burned his ult on someone else", framing the whole late game as damage limitation.
audit.why: It concedes a game Zac wins on the numbers. Sylas is a single-target drain caster who needs an isolated fight; Zac is an AoE engage tank whose value goes up with the number of bodies in the fight. The instruction should be to choose grouped fights, not to avoid Sylas.
audit.corrected: Rewrote late and spikes[3].text around forcing grouped fights where his double-E kiting has no room.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Abscond / Abduct as "matchup-defining" and never mentions Hijack.
audit.why: The dash matters, but the ability that decides this matchup is the one that takes Zac's ultimate. Abscond / Abduct is 13s at rank 1; Hijack is 80s and 950 range, and Zac's single biggest mistake in the matchup is ulting inside that range.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns to lead with Hijack and keep the dash as the secondary track.

edits.before: Level 1 Sylas's chain combo out-trades Zac immediately.
edits.after: Level 1 Sylas has one spell — his Q zones Zac off CS.

edits.before: Level 3 his full Q-E-W combo chunks Zac for free.
edits.after: By 3 Zac's W chip and blobs match Kingslayer.

edits.before: Through 4-5 his sustain and mobility keep him ahead.
edits.after: At 4-5 Grievous Wounds shuts his Kingslayer off.

edits.before: At 6 Hijack steals Zac's R and flips fights to Sylas.
edits.after: At 6 Hijack (80s) takes Let's Bounce! and flips it.

edits.before: First item, his combo spam out-damages Zac's engage.
edits.after: First item, Zac's HP outgrows Sylas's burst ceiling.

edits.before: Late, Sylas's drain and double-E kiting out-scale Zac's telegraphed all-in.
edits.after: Late, Zac's AoE engage decides 5v5s while Sylas needs an isolated target.

edits.before: Sylas out-trades you with his chain combo — Q double-strike, W (Kingslayer) heal on you, and E dash-chain — so every exchange he chunks and heals back while your W burst does little through his sustain.
edits.after: Sylas out-trades you early: Chain Lash (Q) slows, then explodes a beat later, and Kingslayer (W) heals off you from 400 range. Grievous Wounds is the answer — until you have it his W refunds every trade you win.

edits.before: Sylas steals your Let's Bounce! (R) with Hijack, turning your own AoE knock-up against your team — this is the danger window; don't ult near him or in a way he can copy into your backline.
edits.after: Sylas Hijacks Let's Bounce! and turns your own knock-up on your team. Hijack is 80s at rank 1 against your 120s R — he restocks your ultimate faster than you do, so never ult inside his 950 range.

edits.before: Sylas keeps the edge — he's a high-mobility drain caster who ults you or an ally for value, and Zac's telegraphed engage can't pin his double E dash, so he wins the extended fight.
edits.after: Late it turns: Sylas needs an isolated target, while your E-R decides grouped 5v5s outright. Hold anti-heal, engage his backline, and fight where his double-E kiting has nowhere to go.

edits.before: Levels 1-5 are all Sylas: his Q-E chain and Kingslayer W heal let him out-trade and out-sustain you at every level, and your W burst barely dents his self-heal, so farm safe and don't feed his combo.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are Sylas's: Kingslayer heals him off you and Chain Lash pokes for free. From 3 your blob sustain matches him, and once Grievous Wounds lands his W stops paying for the trades he starts.

edits.before: Sylas holds the advantage into items because his double-E mobility dodges your slingshot and his drain keeps him healthy; don't try to solo him — force fights where he's already burned his ult on someone else.
edits.after: Into items you take over: force grouped fights where his double-E kiting has no room and anti-heal has shut off Kingslayer. Don't chase him down the side lane — engage him where your R catches three others too.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Hijack: matchup-defining — 80s at rank 1, 950 range, and it takes your Let's Bounce!. Never ult inside it. - Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1 — bait the dash, then commit. - Your E: never spend it on chip.
